BiblicalUsage: Arisai is named once, as one of the ten sons of Haman, and he is hanged with his brothers after the Jews defend themselves. The verse gives his name and nothing more.
TheologicalSignificance: A name on a list of the judged reminds me that Haman's house fell whole, and that God keeps the record straight, name by name.
